g.text: AI Agent Use Cases - Detailed Multi-Agent Workflow (UML 2.5)
CEO → BA → Architect → OOAD gate → PM → DEV → QC → QA → Marketing
Calls LLM with structured output parsing

8. If tests fail: Retry (up to 2 times)

7. If score ≥80 and no high-severity issues:
3. Write one acceptance test per untested use case
